# @refkit/dsh-plugin
English | 中文
DeepSeek Harness plugin for refkit: license-normalized creative reference search as native agent too
ls, with a web card that shows the license and the use-verdict on every result.
- **`refkit_search`** — one call fans out to up to 24 sources (Openverse images and audio, Met, Art
Institute of Chicago, Wikimedia Commons, Rijksmuseum, Smithsonian, Internet Archive, Project Gutenbe
rg, PoetryDB, Poly Haven textures and HDRIs, ambientCG, Europeana, Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay, Flickr
, Freesound, Jamendo, Brave, nailbook), merges and reranks the results, and returns each with its so
urce id, license id, canonical link, the length of audio and video clips where the source reports it

, and — when you pass an `intent` — a use-verdict and a ready credit line.
- **`refkit_rights`** — r

e-check one license for a different intent without searching again.
- **Web card** — thumbnail grid;
source and license chips on every tile; video posters with a play mark, album art on audio, and an
`m:ss` length badge on both; green / blue / red / amber badges for allowed / credit required / not a
llowed / needs review; one-click credit copy.
Thirteen of the 24 sources work with no key at all (Openverse images and audio, Met, Art Institute o
f Chicago, Wikimedia Commons, Rijksmuseum, Internet Archive, Project Gutenberg, PoetryDB, Poly Haven
textures and HDRIs, ambientCG, nailbook). Add free keys for the rest under **Plugins (sidebar) → re
fkit → Components → refkit**.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart the dsh web host once so the profile picks up the bundle. Tested against `@deepseek-ai/dsh`
0.1.7-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2. Requires dsh 0.1.x from 0.1.7-rc.2 on, or 0.2.x from 0.2.1-rc.2 on (`^0.1
.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-rc.2`); dsh refuses to load it on older releases and on the 0.2.0 pre-releases. ds
h is in developer preview and its plugin API changes between release candidates.
Upgraded dsh to 0.2.1 with refkit 0.2.0 or 0.3.0 installed? dsh 0.2.1 refuses both, so remove the pl
ugin and add it again: `dsh plugin --profile web remove @refkit/dsh-plugin`, then `dsh plugin --prof
ile web add @refkit/dsh-plugin`.
## Configuration
Keys and tuning are set on **Plugins (sidebar) → refkit → Components → refkit** (namespace `refkit`)
; changes apply on the next call, no restart needed. Keys are `secret` fields: never shown on the se
ttings page (only a Set / Not set marker), never logged, never returned to the model, and stored in
the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (file mode 0600, plaintext). Each key left empty falls back to the
environment variables in the table below (`REFKIT_*` first) — the same names `@refkit/mcp` reads, so
one `.env` serves both. An invalid hand-edited `cordis.patch.yml` stops the plugin at startup until
serves both. An invalid hand-edited `cordis.patch.yml` stops the plugin at startup until it's fixed.

## Tools
### `refkit_search`
| Argument | Type | Meaning |

| `query` | string | What to search for |
| `modalities` | `image` `video` `audio` `text` | Default

`["image"]` |
| `intent` | `internal-moodboard` `commercial-product` `ai-generation-input` `redistri

bution` | Annotate every result with a use-verdict and credit line |
| `gateFor` | same | Return onl

y results whose license allows the intent |
| `sources` | string[] | Restrict to source ids (`polyha

ven-hdri` for HDRIs, `openverse-audio` for audio, …) |

tion, color, language, sort, safety, license, media, creator, text, page |

Drop results the reranker scored below this |
| `explain` | boolean | Include per-source diagnostics

e reranker scored below this |
| `explain` | boolean | Include per-source diagnostics under `meta` |
Each result names its `source` id and carries its license, canonical link, thumbnail (a video's post
er, a track's album art) and, for audio and video when the source reports it, `durationSec`; `width`
/`height` are the original's size, or the preview's when the source does not report it.
Example prompts: “find me reference photos of brutalist libraries I can use in a commercial pitch de
ck”, “给我找几张可以商用的赛博朋克街景参考图”, “a public-domain poem about the sea for a poster”, “an outdoor HDRI for
lighting a product render”, “a short rain sound effect for a game trailer”.
### `refkit_rights`
`license`, `intent`, `canonicalUrl` (required); `licenseVersion`, `author`, `title`, `editorialOnly`
, `jurisdiction`, `userJurisdiction`, `facts` (optional). Returns `decision`, `reasons`, `confidence
`, `attribution`, `disclaimer`.
